sloka: सस्कन्धविटपैः सालैः शिलाभिश्च महाबलः।हनुमान् कदनं चक्रे रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम् ।। ६.८२.२० ।।
transliteration: saskandhaviṭapaiḥ sālaiḥ śilābhiśca mahābalaḥ।hanumān kadanaṁ cakre rakṣasāṁ bhīmakarmaṇām ।। 6.82.20 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman made the enemy army retreat, and spoke to his own army," No use of defeating this army for us as our mission is not winning the army."
